description: Defines the CommonMarkConverter class which extends a base Markdown converter to support additional features like table of contents and custom renderers within a Confluence content type library.

classes.name: CommonMarkConverter
classes.description: A custom converter class that extends the base Markdown converter to include extensions for table of contents, customized rendering, and additional features for Confluence integration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the converter with specific configuration for table of contents positioning and heading permalink fragments, then calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: extendEnvironment
methods.description: Extends the given environment by adding necessary extensions and renderers for handling table of contents, code blocks, images, links, and admonition blocks.
